title: Pure Ojama
summary: Ojama cards with Polymerization, generic Links and staples; Ojamatch and Ojama Pajama support Armed Dragon builds and stay out. Ojamas are 0-ATK Level 2 Beasts. Ojamagic searches Ojama Green, Yellow and Black at once when it hits the GY. Ojama Red summons up to four Ojamas from the hand, and Ojama Blue searches two Ojama cards when destroyed in battle. With all three of the trio on the field, Ojama Delta Hurricane!! destroys every card the opponent controls. Ojama Country swaps every monster's ATK and DEF while you control an Ojama, so the 1000-DEF Ojamas hit hard. It also revives an Ojama every turn. Ojama Pink, the newest card, makes both players draw and discard, then locks one of the opponent's Monster Zones. Ojama Emperor gains 3000 ATK under Ojama Country and revives an Ojama. Ojamandala isn't out in the TCG.

allow.Polymerization: Fuses the Ojama trio into Ojama King and Ojama Knight.
allow.ABC-Dragon Buster: Contact Fusion boss providing Quick Effect banishment and tag-out into 3 Union monsters.
allow.A-to-Z-Dragon Buster Cannon: Ultimate Contact Fusion omni-negate that discards cards to negate opposing activations.

exclude.Ojamatch: Also fetches an Armed Dragon; it plays on the Armed Dragon list.
exclude.Ojama Pajama: Protects Armed Dragon and LIGHT Machine Fusion monsters.
